text:
maya: alert — apiserver 5xx spike in asia-north1, controller-manager crashing, many GPU nodes stuck in Attaching. Dashboard: https://redwood.ops/d/abcd/apiserver?orgId=1 :warning:

jon: looking. which clusters?

maya: region=asia-north1, clusters: ai-prod-1, ai-prod-2. error logs from apiserver:
```
W0301 14:22:01.123 request.go:621] apiserver request failed: EOF
E0301 14:22:02.456 controller-runtime: controller-manager panic: kvcache miss: failed to Serve
``` 

eli: controller-manager logs show leader election bounce, leader renewals failing. suspect etcd latency or high etcd wal iops.

sre-bot: alert created: APISERVER_5XX_ASIA_NORTH1 incident-1745556789

charlie: GPUs in 'Attaching' state for >3m, attaching jobs piling up. kubelet logs show timeouts to apiserver: `dial tcp ...:443: i/o timeout`

jon: can we route read-only traffic to eu-west1 as fallback?

maya: routing policy is region-prefer. We can set routing override for ai-prod cluster to eu-west1 for read calls only. Need ops-approval.

eli: quick check: `kubectl get endpoints -n kube-system apiserver -o yaml` shows endpoints flapping. Running `etcdctl endpoint status` returns high RTT.

maya: running temporary kube-apiserver restart on one control plane node to relieve lease pressure. `kubectl cordon` won't help since it's control plane.

deploy-bot: noticed control-plane pod restart: controller-manager/ai-prod-1 restarted by ops

jon: i'm going to bump etcd-backed WAL throughput throttle on nodes and increase etcd client timeout to 12s for the controlplane pods.

charlie: also queuing GPU attach retries with exponential backoff - will avoid hammering controlplane.

maya: do we want to fail fast attachments to free retries? If controllers keep requeueing, controller-manager load will stay high.

eli: suggestion: increase lease duration instead: `--leader-elect-lease-duration=60s` and `--etcd-request-timeout=12s`.

maya: agreed. Let's increase lease duration and client timeouts. Jon, can you apply the change to ai-prod-1 controlplane? I'll update runbook.

jon: applying now. patch below:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: controller-manager
spec:
  containers:
  - name: controller-manager
    args:
    - --leader-elect-lease-duration=60s
    - --etcd-servers=https://10.0.0.5:2379
    - --etcd-request-timeout=12s
```
`kubectl apply -f -`

sre-bot: autoscaler noticed surge; subdued for now.

maya: after restart, apiserver 5xx rate dropped to baseline. GPU attach backlog now draining. :thumbsup:

charlie: observed one pod stuck, manual delete worked. monitoring for a few more minutes.

eli: follow-up: create alert for etcd WAL iops >80% and set runbook link: https://redwood.ops/runbooks/etcd-wal-iops

maya: noted. filed ticket INFRA-5943. :spiral_note_pad:

jon: leaving a note in the cluster doc about default leader lease tuning for gpu-heavy clusters.

charlie: :eyes: keep an eye on asia-north1 for 30m.
